body:
A new threat emerges from the stars as the new boss Jupiter arrives. Explore the newly discovered Geardock and gear up with the new Astra Secondary Weapons! Complete new missions and transcend even further with Destiny 2nd Transcendence Weapon. Kinesis returns with fresh updates and with the Kinetic event you can grab a Hyper Burninator to speed up your growth. Buckle up for Ride or Die and challenge weekly bosses for weekly rewards! Operation: Dive has a new roguelite dungeon ready for you to explore and the Night of Phantasms lingers on with the Fantasia Finale!

[Defeat Boss Event] God Devourer

Normal Clear Mission: July 23, 2026 12:00 AM UTC - August 19, 2026 11:59 PM UTC

Reward Claim Period: July 23, 2026 12:00 AM UTC - August 20, 2026 2:00 AM UTC

The God Devourer, Jupiter, has arrived and it’s your time to defeat him! Participate in the God Devourer event to earn rewards based on your difficulty level.

Requirement

  • Lv. 295 and above characters that have completed the [Geardock] area quests. (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).

How to Participate

  • Select 'God Devourer' from the event list and click the ‘Participate’ button.

Clear Mission and Rewards

  • Defeat Jupiter at least once during the event period to claim the clear rewards from the Event List.
  • Clearing at a higher difficulty automatically qualifies you for all lower-tier difficulty rewards.
  • You must enter the Reward Map after defeating Jupiter (Normal) or Jupiter (Hard) to complete the mission.
  • You can still participate even if you defeat the boss in a party of 2 or more players.
  • Rewards cannot be claimed for clears completed in Practice Mode or Story Mode.

Defeat Mission

Reward

Jupiter (Normal)

Miniature Kronos: Tradable within world, Permanent.

Jupiter (Hard)
  • Gluttony's End Coupon: Tradable within world, 7-day duration. Use to receive:
    • Gluttony’s End: Untradable, Permanent.
  • Balanced Label/Chat Ring Coupon: Tradable within world, 7-day duration. Use to receive the following:
    • Balanced Label: Untradable, Permanent.
    • Balanced Chat: Untradable, Permanent.
  • Forge of the Gods Background Coupon: Tradable within world, 7-day duration. Use to receive:
    • Forge of the Gods Background: Untradable, Permanent.
  • Seething Balance Appearance Effect Coupon: Tradable within world, 7-day duration. Use to receive:
    • Seething Balance Appearance Effect: Untradable, Permanent.

Rewards can be claimed until August 20, 2026 2:00 AM UTC.

Celebration Event Rewards

Given to all players when Jupiter (Hard) is defeated during the event period.

  • 4x EXP Coupon (30 min) (x2): Tradable within world, expires August 20, 2026 2:00 AM UTC.
  • Luxe Sauna Coupon (x4): Tradable within world, expires August 20, 2026 2:00 AM UTC.
  • Advanced EXP Voucher (x1000): Tradable within world, expires August 20, 2026 2:00 AM UTC.
  • Jupiter Alchemical Pentacle Coupon: Tradable within world, expires August 20, 2026 2:00 AM UTC. Use to receive:
    • Jupiter Alchemical Pentacle: Untradable, Permanent.

Rewards can be claimed once per account and expires August 20, 2026 2:00 AM UTC.

    • Complete the Geardock region quests to receive one Grand Sacred Symbol: Geardock.

Astra Secondary Weapon

The Astra Secondary Weapon is a new Lv. 200 secondary weapon that can be obtained and further enhanced by completing Secondary Weapon Quests.

Requirement

  • Lv. 265 and above characters that completed the following quests:
    • ‘[Hotel Arcus] ‘Til We Meet Again’
    • ‘[Genesis Weapon] Lingering Question and Fresh Start]’

How to Participate

  • Select the ‘[Astra Secondary Weapon] An Emergency Arrest’ quest through the lightbulb notifier on the left side of the screen to start.
  • Complete the ‘[Astra Secondary Weapon]’ questline to unlock the Secondary Weapon Quest UI.
  • The Secondary Weapon Quest UI can be opened at any time through the ‘[Astra Secondary Weapon] Erion Enhancement’ quest.

Secondary Weapon Quests

  • There are 3 Secondary Weapon quests to complete where each quest requires a certain amount of Vestiges of Erion and Traces of Battle.

    • Complete the 2nd and 3rd quests to upgrade and further enhance your Astra Secondary Weapon.

    • Terminus Shields at 27 Stars or higher will be treated as a 26-Star Terminus Shield when calculating the transfer cost.

  • Progress through multiple stages featuring sweeps and boss battles.

  • All stages must be completed within a total time of 30 minutes.

Luxe Sauna

June 17, 2026 - September 8, 2026 11:59 PM UTC

Requirement

  • Lv. 101 and above characters (Zero characters must have completed Story Quest Act 2).

How to Participate

  • Access the Luxe Sauna UI through the Event List to charge time and view your cumulative charged hours.
    • Characters with a Burning effect can participate.
  • Once the Luxe Sauna been charged, click the 'Enter' button in the Luxe Sauna UI or speak with the Hotel Receptionist in Sleepywood to move to the Luxe Sauna.
    • The Luxe Sauna cannot be accessed if there are no available charges.
  • The Luxe Sauna usage time is shared across all characters on the same account.
    • Charged time only decreases while your character is inside the Luxe Sauna Room.
    • Charged time will not decrease while you are logged out or outside the room.
  • When the event period ends, any remaining charged time cannot be used and EXP can no longer be obtained.

Luxe Sauna EXP Details

  • While inside the Luxe Sauna Room, characters receive EXP every 5 seconds based on their level.
  • Characters Lv. 295 and above receive the same amount of EXP as Lv. 294 characters.
  • Your character will be automatically removed from Luxe Sauna when all charged time has been used.
  • You can enable an option to automatically exit the Luxe Sauna once your character reaches a specific level. The character will return to Sleepywood or or their original location.

Charging Luxe Sauna Time

  • There are two ways to charge Luxe Sauna usage time:
    • For 3,000 Maple Points, 1 hour of Luxe Sauna usage time can be charged.
    • Use Luxe Sauna Coupons obtained from event rewards.
      • Each Luxe Sauna Coupon charges 30 minutes of usage time.
      • Coupons can only be used during the event period in which they were obtained.
  • Charged time cannot exceed the remaining duration of the event.
  • Up to 48 hours of usage time can be charged per week.
  • The weekly charge limit resets every Wednesday at 12:00 AM UTC.

Cumulative Time Rewards

  • Earn furnishing rewards based on your total cumulative Luxe Sauna charged time during the event. Cumulative charged time is permanently recorded and will be kept even after the event period ends.
  • Rewards can only be claimed once per account.
